            subtree_size[u] = len(order_list) - entry[u]
    
    # Process queries
    results = []
    for _ in range(q):
        u = int(next(iterator))
        k = int(next(iterator))
        
        if k > subtree_size[u]:
            results.append("-1")
        else:
            idx = entry[u] + k - 1
            results.append(str(order_list[idx]))
    
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(results) + '\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    solve()
